title: Bisphenol A and F exposure suppresses MMP9 to drive nasal epithelial inflammation and senescence: a protective target for allergic rhinitis.
authors: Liu, Min; Zhao, Tianxin; Liu, Yijun; Yang, Hua; Gu, Zheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究双酚A/F暴露通过抑制MMP9驱动鼻上皮炎症与衰老，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是环境毒理与过敏性鼻炎病理，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Allergic rhinitis (AR) is a prevalent inflammatory disorder of the upper airways, and exposure to environmental endocrine-disrupting chemicals such as bisphenol A (BPA) and bisphenol F (BPF) has been implicated in its pathogenesis, yet the underlying molecular mechanisms remain poorly understood. We integrated network toxicology, bioinformatics, and machine learning approaches to identify key target genes linking BPA/BPF exposure to AR, followed by molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) to evaluate binding affinities. In vitro experiments using human nasal epithelial cells (HNEpC) were conducted to validate the effects of BPA/BPF on cell viability, apoptosis, inflammatory cytokines, senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), and the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, with further functional assessment via MMP9 overexpression. Four common genes (MAPT, MMP9, CHRM3, ESR2) were identified for BPA and three (MMP9, CHRM3, ESR2) for BPF. SPR confirmed direct binding of both bisphenols to MMP9 with KD values of 3.46 muM (BPA) and 9.47 muM (BPF). BPA/BPF treatment inhibited cell viability, suppressed MMP9, promoted apoptosis, upregulated IL-4, IL-6, IL-8, IL-13, CCL2, TNF-alpha, and IL-1beta, downregulated MMP1, and suppressed the NF-kappaB pathway. MMP9 overexpression reversed these effects. Our findings demonstrate that BPA and BPF promote AR pathogenesis through MMP9 suppression, SASP activation, and NF-kappaB inhibition, identifying MMP9 as a potential therapeutic target for pollutant-exacerbated AR.
abstract_zh: 过敏性鼻炎（AR）是一种常见的上气道炎症性疾病，环境内分泌干扰物如双酚A（BPA）和双酚F（BPF）的暴露已被认为与其发病机制相关，但其潜在的分子机制仍知之甚少。我们整合了网络毒理学、生物信息学和机器学习方法，以识别连接BPA/BPF暴露与AR的关键靶基因，随后通过分子对接、分子动力学模拟和表面等离子体共振（SPR）评估结合亲和力。使用人鼻上皮细胞（HNEpC）进行体外实验，以验证BPA/BPF对细胞活力、凋亡、炎症细胞因子、衰老相关分泌表型（SASP）及NF-kappaB信号通路的影响，并通过MMP9过表达进行进一步功能评估。为BPA识别出四个共同基因（MAPT、MMP9、CHRM3、ESR2），为BPF识别出三个（MMP9、CHRM3、ESR2）。SPR确认了两种双酚类化合物与MMP9的直接结合，其KD值分别为3.46 μM（BPA）和9.47 μM（BPF）。BPA/BPF处理抑制了细胞活力，抑制了MMP9，促进了凋亡，上调了IL-4、IL-6、IL-8、IL-13、CCL2、TNF-alpha和IL-1beta，下调了MMP1，并抑制了NF-kappaB通路。MMP9过表达逆转了这些效应。我们的研究结果表明，BPA和BPF通过MMP9抑制、SASP激活和NF-kappaB抑制促进AR发病机制，将MMP9确定为污染物加剧AR的潜在治疗靶点。
